color.surface.base: Background of the page and of most panels
color.surface.raised: Background of cards and other surfaces that sit above the page
color.surface.sunken: Background of wells and areas set below the page, such as table headers
color.surface.overlay: Background of menus, popovers and dialogs
color.text.muted: Secondary text such as hints and captions
color.text.inverse: Text on a dark or strongly colored background
color.border.strong: Border of inputs and of elements that need more contrast
color.neutral.base: Solid neutral color, for neutral buttons and badges
color.neutral.soft: Soft neutral background, for subtle badges and chips
color.neutral.on: Text and icons on the solid neutral color
color.accent.base: Solid brand color, for primary buttons and links
color.accent.soft: Soft brand background, for selected rows and highlights
color.accent.on: Text and icons on the solid brand color
color.danger.base: Solid color for errors and destructive actions
color.danger.on: Text and icons on the solid danger color
color.warning.on: Text and icons on the solid warning color
color.success.on: Text and icons on the solid success color
color.info.on: Text and icons on the solid info color
color.backdrop: Dimming layer behind modals and drawers
color.data.categorical.1: Series color 1 of 8 for unordered categories, told apart from its neighbours with common color-vision deficiencies
color.data.categorical.2: Series color 2 of 8 for unordered categories, told apart from its neighbours with common color-vision deficiencies

color.data.categorical.8: Series color 8 of 8 for unordered categories, told apart from its neighbours with common color-vision deficiencies
color.data.sequential.1: Step 1 of 7 for ordered values; each step has more contrast with the surface than the one before
color.data.sequential.2: Step 2 of 7 for ordered values; each step has more contrast with the surface than the one before
color.data.sequential.3: Step 3 of 7 for ordered values; each step has more contrast with the surface than the one before

color.data.sequential.7: Step 7 of 7 for ordered values; each step has more contrast with the surface than the one before
color.data.diverging.neg3: Strongest negative step of the diverging scale for values around a midpoint
color.data.diverging.neg2: Medium negative step of the diverging scale for values around a midpoint
color.data.diverging.neg1: Weak negative step of the diverging scale for values around a midpoint
color.data.diverging.zero: Midpoint, neither negative nor positive step of the diverging scale for values around a midpoint
color.data.diverging.pos1: Weak positive step of the diverging scale for values around a midpoint
color.data.diverging.pos2: Medium positive step of the diverging scale for values around a midpoint
color.data.diverging.pos3: Strongest positive step of the diverging scale for values around a midpoint
space.gap.sm: Small gap between neighbouring items in a row or column
space.gap.md: Medium gap between neighbouring items in a row or column
space.gap.lg: Large gap between neighbouring items in a row or column
space.stack.sm: Small vertical space between blocks of content
space.stack.md: Medium vertical space between blocks of content
space.stack.lg: Large vertical space between blocks of content
size.control.sm: Height of a small control such as a button or input
size.control.md: Height of a medium control such as a button or input
size.control.lg: Height of a large control such as a button or input
size.icon.sm: Width and height of a small icon
size.icon.md: Width and height of a medium icon
size.icon.lg: Width and height of a large icon
radius.sm: Small corner radius, for inputs and badges
radius.md: Medium corner radius, for buttons and cards
radius.lg: Large corner radius, for dialogs and large panels
radius.full: Fully rounded corners, for pills and avatars
elevation.flat.shadow: Shadow of a surface level with the page (none)
elevation.flat.layer: Stacking order of a flat surface
elevation.raised.shadow: Shadow of cards and raised surfaces
elevation.raised.layer: Stacking order of a raised surface
elevation.overlay.layer: Stacking order of menus and popovers
elevation.modal.layer: Stacking order of modals and drawers
text.display.family: Font family of display text, the largest style
text.label.family: Font family of labels and button text
text.label.size: Font size of labels and button text
text.label.weight: Font weight of labels and button text
text.label.leading: Line height of labels and button text
text.caption.family: Font family of captions and hints
text.caption.size: Font size of captions and hints
text.caption.weight: Font weight of captions and hints
text.caption.leading: Line height of captions and hints
text.code.family: Font family of code and other monospace text
motion.duration.fast: Duration of quick transitions such as hover changes
motion.duration.slow: Duration of large transitions such as drawers opening
motion.easing.standard: Easing of transitions that stay on screen
motion.easing.enter: Easing of elements entering the screen
motion.easing.exit: Easing of elements leaving the screen
density.factor: Multiplier applied to every spacing token; 1 is normal
density.compact: The density factor of the compact density
density.comfortable: The density factor of the comfortable density
density.spacious: The density factor of the spacious density
focus.offset: Distance between an element and its focus ring
